My dear Miss Yonge,

I return the France, which indeed I ought to have done yesterday, when I wrote you that I had seen the delegates.

I shall quite count on your doing the smaller book for us, as you kindly agree.

Mrs [Craik](../persons.html#378) suggests “Heroic Lives of all times &.” I adhere to the [Book of Worthies](../books.html#80).

Yours very faithfully

[A.

Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
